title: Stacked demand funnel and initial scope decomposer
creator: Ethan Rodriguez
description: Create a repeatable 'stacked demand' intake pipeline that aggregates enterprise feature requests from Sales/CS, normalizes signals into demand buckets, and outputs a prioritized set of 'implementation slices' with rough engineering estimates and deployment constraints. This ticket builds the lightweight workflow: intake form + normalization heuristics + priority scoring + initial scoping template + delivery readiness checklist. Aim is to reduce back-and-forth between Sales and Eng and speed first-response scoping to <48h for high-touch accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form (Google Form + Slack shortcut) fieldset finalized and published
Normalization ruleset (mapping of Sales labels to demand buckets) documented and validated with 3 CS reps
Priority scoring rubric implemented in a templated spreadsheet and verified on 20 historical asks
Initial scoping template (mini-PRD) created and adopted by CS for new enterprise asks
Hand-off checklist to Eng created with clear dependencies and estimated T-shirt sizes
Pilot run completed with two enterprise accounts and time-to-first-scope <48h for high-priority items
notes: Scope decomposer targets non-bug feature asks only. Focus on intake signals that indicate sustained product changes (routing, capacity, security, billing, admin UX). Do not include time-limited troubleshooting tickets. Use historical dataset from Jan-Jun 2025 to calibrate scoring weights. Consider model seller constraints: Dedicated and Private customers often require extra security and rollout lead time.
